answer: Agents tending a terrace garden and a jetty lantern can share one governance permit per human controller. At globally simultaneous physical enrollment sessions, independent stewards issue one credential per attendee. Every delegated agent derives the same election nullifier from that credential; validators accept it once, so a hundred aliases still cast one vote. An attacker must recruit additional people rather than generate keys. Paid proxies and corrupt stewards remain threats, so this trades automated entry for accountable human enrollment.
